abstract: Two cases of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma to the lungs have been encountered that presented unusual histologic patterns. Both lesions were solitary metastases that followed multiple courses of chemotherapy, and the patients had low serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels. Surgical excision appeared to be curative in both cases. Both neoplasms were characterized by a predominance of uniform but highly atypical mononucleate trophoblastic cells. These cells infiltrated pulmonary parenchyma, forming nests of tumor with central dense necrotic debris. Syncytiotrophoblastic cells (STB) were present but showed scant cytoplasm and little vacuolization. Hemorrhage was only focal. Immunohistochemistry revealed that some of the multinucleate STB and occasional mononucleate cells produced hCG, while human placental lactogen was focally produced in the tumors. By electron microscopy the STB were identified but lacked open lacunae lined by microvilli. Most mononucleate cells showed greater maturation evidenced by a more complex cytoplasm than is seen in typical cytotrophoblastic cells (CTB). The results suggest that these tumors are a distinctive subtype of choriocarcinoma composed largely of a form of trophoblastic cell with features intermediate between CTB and STB, yet different from the intermediate trophoblast of the placental site tumor. Identification of this morphologic variant of choriocarcinoma may have clinical utility as additional cases are studied.
abstract_ja: 多剤化学療法後に肺へ単発転移をきたし、非典型的な組織像を示した転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の2例を報告する。両症例とも血清β-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値は低値であった。両腫瘍は、中間的特徴を持つ均一だが高度に異型な単核栄養膜細胞が主体であり、壊死性デブリを中心に持つ腫瘍胞巣を形成しながら肺実質に浸潤していた。合胞体栄養膜細胞は認められたが、細胞質は乏しく空胞化もわずかであった。出血は限局的にとどまった。免疫組織化学では、多核の合胞体栄養膜細胞と一部の単核細胞がhCGを産生し、腫瘍内に局所的にヒト胎盤性ラクトーゲンの産生も認められた。電子顕微鏡では合胞体栄養膜細胞が同定されたが、微絨毛で覆われた開放性の腔は欠いていた。多くの単核細胞は、典型的な細胞性栄養膜細胞よりも複雑な細胞質を持ち、より成熟した所見を示した。これらの結果は、腫瘍が細胞性栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞の中間的特徴を持つ栄養膜細胞から主になり、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の中間型トロホブラストとも異なることを示唆している。この形態学的変異型の同定は、症例の蓄積に伴い臨床的に有用となる可能性がある。
